prompts.title: Website
prompts.summary: One original, polished website on a subject the model invents.
prompts.requirement: 5+ screens or sections, real copy, bespoke SVG art, one working interactive element

prompts.title: Useful app
prompts.summary: A complete everyday tool with data, persistence, undo and built-in self-checks.
prompts.requirement: 3 end-to-end workflows, undo, JSON import/export, 10 self-checks that pass

prompts.title: Algorithms lab
prompts.summary: Implement algorithms from scratch, visualise them step by step, then test them in the page.
prompts.requirement: 6+ algorithms with step animations, 30+ assertions, editable code that re-runs the tests

prompts.title: Simulation tool
prompts.summary: A physical or control system with stated equations, live plots and an analytic self-check.
prompts.requirement: 5+ scenarios, 3+ live plots, CSV export, solver self-check

prompts.title: three.js scenes
prompts.summary: A real-time 3D piece in three.js with custom shaders and a clear visual idea.
prompts.requirement: Custom GLSL, interaction, delta-time animation, no external model or texture files

prompts.title: 2D games
prompts.summary: Three different playable 2D games, built for game feel: shake, hit-stop, particles and sound.
prompts.requirement: Juice (6+ per game), win and lose states, pause, high score, self-test that passes

prompts.title: 3D games
prompts.summary: Three different playable 3D games in three.js, each with real game feel and a custom shader.
prompts.requirement: Custom ShaderMaterial, juice (6+ per game), win and lose, high score, self-test that passes

prompts.title: Procedural images
prompts.summary: Original pictures generated purely in code, each by a different technique.
prompts.requirement: One large render per file, seeded and reproducible, 3+ sliders, palette, PNG download

prompts.title: Short animated film
prompts.summary: A 45-90 second animated film built in code, with its own soundtrack and a timeline.
prompts.requirement: 5-7 scenes with transitions, synthesised soundtrack, scrubbing timeline, WebM recording

prompts.title: Tool-calling playground
prompts.summary: Design tools, plan multi-step requests with them, and trace every call.
prompts.requirement: 6+ tools with schemas, 6+ requests incl. chained calls, honest refusals, 12 checks that pass

prompts.title: Academic explainer
prompts.summary: A rigorous interactive explainer on a topic the model chooses, with honest references.
prompts.requirement: Correct mathematics, 3+ sliders that change results, worked example, 5-question quiz

prompts.title: Fun toys
prompts.summary: Three playful, creative toys with no score: sound, sandbox, brushes, and more, each with a hidden surprise.
prompts.requirement: Clear first interaction in 2 seconds, 3+ modes, a hidden surprise, Save PNG, URL-shareable state
